scope: Three project-new closed historical issues from encode/httpx, pytest-dev/pytest and astral-sh/ruff, selected independently after freezing M2 code. A small purposive acceptance set, not a representative quality benchmark or proof of absence from model pretraining.

cases.selection_reason: A concise reproducible reported API disappearance with exact stable/prerelease versions, commands and two comments; tests attribution and prerelease interpretation.
review_checks: Preserve the supplied upgrade command, 0.28.1-to-1.0.dev1 comparison and missing BaseTransport attribute; do not re-request these supplied details or claim execution.

Treat this as a reported compatibility observation involving a prerelease. Do not invent accidental removal, a confirmed stable-release defect, an interchangeable replacement API, or a verified fix/release.
Use available comments to attribute the acknowledgement of a 1.0 prerelease and distinguish a linked discussion from discussion content actually retrieved; acknowledge closed/historical status.
Ground any label and comparison in the loaded catalog and both issue bodies. Keep optional environment questions separate from essential missing reproduction details.

cases.selection_reason: A concise symptom report with partial implementation clues and eleven comments, including a reproducer request but no complete runnable class/test; tests missing-information triage and existing-label handling.
review_checks: Identify the missing executable custom-wrapper definition and parametrized test or invocation without claiming the report contains no clues; the body already gives a KeyError, custom dict wrapper and a Python314 path.

When visible, preserve the author's __getattr__/__setattr__ clarification and workaround separately from RonnyPfannschmidt's explanation and explicit pytest.param(..., id=...) suggestion. Do not re-request information already supplied in visible comments.
Do not turn the reporter's regression claim or a participant's explanation into independently verified root cause. Request a focused minimal reproducer and use a neutral maintainer voice.

Do not recommend an already applied status: needs information label. Preserve partial pagination/omission states for the eleven-comment discussion; unread or omitted evidence must not be described as absent.

cases.selection_reason: A concise new-rule request with one code example and one documentation-link comment; tests feature intent and the boundary between a link and retrieved implementation evidence.
review_checks: Recognize a proposed lint rule for top-level use that immediately resolves a lazy import, preserving the short supplied code example and motivation rather than treating it as a crash report.

A participant links the lazy-import-immediately-resolved documentation page. Attribute that link when visible; do not claim the page was read or assert a current implementation/release version from the URL or closed state alone.
Do not demand bug-only tracebacks, operating-system details or reproduction fields for this feature request. Any follow-up about intended rule behavior must remain a focused design question.
Keep labels and candidate relationships evidence-linked and tentative; compare only fully retrieved bodies. Treat template required-state and skipped lookups honestly.
